title: n7 grade undo redo
description:
The editor side of N7: the GradeHistory stack becomes reachable.
ClipEditorScreen owns one history per clip open, in remember(sourceId)
beside the grade state and seeded with the clip's initial grade -
switching clips resets it with every other piece of per-clip editor
state.

Every grade mutation now funnels through applyGradeEdit, which writes
the grade, calls onGradeChange (persistence and render unchanged:
stores.grades.put plus the existing trailing-debounce render effect)
and records into the history. The cause argument picks the coalescing
behavior: slider onChange frames record with GradeHistory.SLIDER_GESTURE
so one finger drag is one undo step; discrete edits - toggles, tonemap
and LUT choices, paste and preset applies - record with a null cause
and never coalesce. Double-tap resets move to their own onReset
route: they used to ride onChange, and a reset sharing the slider
caus
changed: feat: grade undo redo history stack
feat: editor undo redo wiring and affordance
